name: Break glass / Tenant guardrails
text:
let btg = users
| where userPrincipalName in~ ({Accounts})
| project userId = id, upn = userPrincipalName, enabled = coalesce(accountEnabled, false), synced = coalesce(onPremisesSyncEnabled, false), userType, assignedLicenses, passwordPolicies, lastPasswordChangeDateTime, signInActivity, memberOf, ownedObjects, authenticationMethods;
let btgGroups = btg
| project userId, upn, membershipRead = isnotnull(memberOf)
| join kind=leftouter (btg | mv-expand g = memberOf | where tostring(g.objectType) == "group" | summarize groupIds = make_set(tostring(g.id)) by userId) on userId
| project userId, upn, membershipRead, groupIds = coalesce(groupIds, dynamic([]));
let premium = subscribedSkus
| where capabilityStatus == "Enabled"
| mv-expand plan = servicePlans
| where tostring(plan.servicePlanName) in ("AAD_PREMIUM", "AAD_PREMIUM_P2")
| summarize plans = count();
let secDefaults = policies_identitySecurityDefaultsEnforcementPolicy
| project defaultsOn = coalesce(isEnabled, false);
let fido = policies_authenticationMethodsPolicy_authenticationMethodConfigurations
| where id == "Fido2"
| project state, excludeTargets, includeTargets, keyRestrictions;
union
    (btg | summarize accounts = count() | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.AccountCount", Target = "tenant", Status = iff(accounts < 2, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(accounts < 2, strcat("Only ", accounts, " break-glass account(s) found. Microsoft recommends at least two, with credentials kept in separate places."), strcat(accounts, " break-glass accounts."))),
    (premium | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.EntraPremium", Target = "tenant", Status = iff(plans > 0, "PASS", "WARN"),
        Detail = iff(plans > 0, "Entra ID P1 or P2 is present, so Conditional Access is licensed.", "No Entra ID P1 or P2 service plan found; Conditional Access may be unlicensed.")),
    (secDefaults
    | summarize objects = count()
    | where objects == 0
    | extend Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.SecurityDefaultsOff", Target = "tenant", Status = "ERROR",
        Detail = "The Security Defaults policy couldn't be read (needs Policy.Read.All)."
    | project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail),
    (secDefaults | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.SecurityDefaultsOff", Target = "tenant", Status = iff(defaultsOn, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(defaultsOn, "Security Defaults are on: they require MFA registration and can block a break-glass sign-in. Turn them off and use Conditional Access.", "Security Defaults are off.")),
    (fido
    | extend k = 1
    | join kind=leftouter (fido | mv-expand target = includeTargets | summarize includedIds = make_set(tostring(target.id)) | extend k = 1) on k
    | join kind=inner (btgGroups | extend k = 1) on k
    | extend includedIds = coalesce(includedIds, dynamic([])), enabled = state == "enabled"
    | extend all = set_has_element(includedIds, "all_users"), direct = set_has_element(includedIds, userId),
        viaGroup = array_length(set_intersect(includedIds, groupIds)) > 0
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2MethodEnabled", Target = upn, Status = case(enabled and (all or direct or viaGroup), "PASS", enabled and not(membershipRead), "ERROR", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(not(enabled), strcat("The FIDO2 security key method is ", state, "."),
            not(all or direct) and not(membershipRead), "The account's groups couldn't be read, so whether the FIDO2 method targets it through a group isn't known (needs GroupMember.Read.All or Directory.Read.All).",
            all, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled for all users.",
            direct, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled and targets the account directly.",
            viaGroup, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled for a group the account is in.",
            "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled, but not for the account or any group it is in, so it can't register or use a key.")),
    (fido
    | mv-expand target = excludeTargets
    | project excludedId = tostring(target.id), k = 1
    | join kind=inner (btgGroups | extend k = 1) on k
    | where excludedId == userId or set_has_element(groupIds, excludedId)
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2NotExcluded", Target = upn, Status = "FAIL",
        Detail = "The account, or a group it is in, is excluded from the FIDO2 method, so it can't sign in with its key."),
    (fido
    | summarize policies = count()
    | where policies == 0
    | extend Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2MethodEnabled", Target = "tenant", Status = "ERROR",
        Detail = "The FIDO2 method policy couldn't be read (needs Policy.Read.AuthenticationMethod)."
    | project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail),
    (fido
    | where tobool(keyRestrictions.isEnforced)
    | project enforcement = tostring(keyRestrictions.enforcementType), allowList = tolower(tostring(keyRestrictions.aaGuids)), k = 1
    | join kind=inner (btg
        | mv-expand m = authenticationMethods
        | where tostring(m.objectType) == "fido2AuthenticationMethod"
        | project upn, key = coalesce(tostring(m.model), tostring(m.displayName), "FIDO2 key"), aaGuid = tolower(tostring(m.aaGuid)), k = 1) on k
    | extend listed = isnotempty(aaGuid) and allowList contains aaGuid
    | extend ok = iff(enforcement == "allow", listed, not(listed))
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2KeyAllowed", Target = strcat(upn, " | ", key), Status = iff(ok, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(ok and enforcement == "allow", "The key's model is on the FIDO2 policy's allow list.",
            ok, "The key's model isn't on the FIDO2 policy's block list.",
            enforcement == "allow", strcat("The key's model (AAGUID ", aaGuid, ") isn't on the FIDO2 policy's allow list, so the key can't be used. Add the model to the list or replace the key."),
            strcat("The key's model (AAGUID ", aaGuid, ") is on the FIDO2 policy's block list, so the key can't be used. Replace the key.")))
| extend Rank = case(Status == "FAIL", 0, Status == "ERROR", 1, Status == "WARN", 2, Status == "INFO", 3, 4)
| order by Rank asc, Category asc, Check asc, Target asc
| project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail
